sloka: केचित्समुद्रे पतिताः केचिद्गगनमाश्रिताः।वध्यमानास्तु ते वीरा राक्षसेन बलीयसा ।। ६.६६.१५ ।।
transliteration: kecitsamudre patitāḥ kecidgaganamāśritāḥ।vadhyamānāstu te vīrā rākṣasena balīyasā ।। 6.66.15 ।।

translations.english: Struck by Rakshasa, the Vanaras ran in the same path crossing the ocean (by which they came).
